name: openclaw-firefly
description: Security-constrained Firefly III rule proposal tools for OpenClaw

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run plugin:build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js --check && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
